pages.text: $(item)Clothing$() is a type of $(thing)equipment$() that provides effects other than $(l:game_mechanics/damage_types)armor$().$(br2)Most clothes affect your $(l:game_mechanics/player_temperature)player temperature$(), but others can provide additional, useful effects.
Clothing can be worn in your normal equipment slots, but it can also be worn in your $(thing)Curios slots$() to wear other equipment at the same time.
